description: This file defines the FooTable.Editing component, which adds editing capabilities (edit, delete, view, add) to a FooTable instance, including UI creation, event handling, and configuration.

classes.name: F.Editing
classes.description: A component extending FooTable.Component that manages row editing, adding, deleting, and viewing functionalities with associated UI and event handling.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes the editing component, setting up configuration options, callbacks, and UI elements based on table options.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Checks and applies data and options for the editing component before UI creation, including event raising.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the editing component, raising an event before UI generation.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the editing UI and cleans up event handlers, raising an event before destruction.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates the editing UI, including buttons and event bindings.

methods.name: $buttonShow
methods.description: Returns HTML for the show button.

methods.name: $buttonHide
methods.description: Returns HTML for the hide button.

methods.name: $buttonAdd
methods.description: Returns HTML for the add button.

methods.name: $buttonEdit
methods.description: Returns HTML for the edit button.

methods.name: $buttonDelete
methods.description: Returns HTML for the delete button.

methods.name: $buttonView
methods.description: Returns HTML for the view button.

methods.name: $rowButtons
methods.description: Creates and returns the button group for row actions.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Adjusts the UI layout, particularly the colspan of the cell.

methods.name: _onEditClick
methods.description: Handles click event for the edit button, raising an event and executing callback.

methods.name: _onDeleteClick
methods.description: Handles click event for the delete button, raising an event and executing callback.

methods.name: _onViewClick
methods.description: Handles click event for the view button, raising an event and executing callback.

methods.name: _onAddClick
methods.description: Handles click event for the add button, raising an event and executing callback.

methods.name: _onShowClick
methods.description: Handles click event for the show button, raising an event and toggling visibility.

methods.name: _onHideClick
methods.description: Handles click event for the hide button, raising an event and toggling visibility.
